body.objective: Determine whether the infrared-singular Appendix-C BT squeeze can be realized on the smallest explicit extended carrier, including the full exponential rather than only its first sector, and decide whether that carrier inherits a positive cyclic generalized-Born trace.
depends_on: Lill arXiv:2208.03487v2 extended bosonic implementation architecture
body.current_gate: EXTENDED_SQUEEZE_CARRIER: derive the exact full-series convergence conditions, construct or rule out an infrared-weighted topology, and audit whether positive-Hilbert Bogoliubov extension theorems apply to the cross-Krein BT shear.
body.stop_condition: Produce an explicit extended carrier with its modewise contraction, summability, topology, adjoint, and trace properties certified, or prove the first exact obstruction preventing such a carrier from supporting the BT generalized Born rule.
body.forbid: no first-sector finiteness promoted to convergence of the exponential; no inequivalent topology called an equivalent fundamental symmetry; no positive-Hilbert Bogoliubov theorem imported for a merely cross-Krein-canonical map; no formal extended vector space called a positive Hilbert space or cyclic trace; no scalar-to-gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL transfer
body.resource_hint: Factorize the finite-box exponential over unordered momentum pairs. Keep the modewise |z|<1 condition separate from square summability and from the thermodynamic-volume limit. Run all commands sequentially under ulimit -v 500000.
